notes.title: Why StarPlayerVR is better!
notes.content:
Ok, now there're plenty of video players out there on the steamvr market already.  
Aside from the common features such as distance adjustment, screen color tuning, or adding to favorites, here's a list of the killer points how this player defeats the competition:
[list]
[*] Progress bar preview (when hovering on the progress bar, you can see the preview for the video)
[*] 3D support for 180/360 local and youtube videos, too (other video players may support only regular 3D videos)
[*] Support for embedded subtitles and audio tracks 
[*] Support external subtitle files. (The files can be anywhere on the hard disk)
[*] Youtube HD (1080p, 1440p) supported. (You get a dropdown list to choose the desired resolution)
[*] Youtube video detail page (displaying like/dislike counts, video length, description, and a list of relevant videos)
[*] Video A B point loop 
[*] Vive headgear's front camera supported. You are able to see the surrounding even with the headgear on.
[*] Display video also on regular window.  (Your girlfriend next to you can watch the video with you on the monitor.)
[*] If you don't like the built-in scenery, you can also use the background downloaded from SteamVR workshop.
[*] Best of all, the developer is still alive, does response very quickly, and takes in feature requests.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Note
notes.content:
Ver 1.1.0.0 - 2017/06/23
[list]
    [*] Now able to display the video content to the desktop window, so your surrounding friend can watch it with you, too... (This is not a shared screen across internet, don't get confused)
    [*] Allow user to adjust the position y.
[/list]

Ver 1.0.6.0 - 2017/05/30
[list]
    [*] Now you can use your downloaded background from SteamVR workshop.
    [*] Fixed an audio track issue (After you play a youtube video, when you play a local file, the previous youtube video's audio track will be also played.)
[/list]

Ver 1.0.4.1 - 2017/05/18
[list]
    [*] Now support Youtube 1080p, 1440p videos.
    [*] Add a dropdown list for user to select desired Youtube resolution.
[/list]

Ver 1.0.4 - 2017/05/16
[list]
    [*] Add support to more subtitle format: .srt, .ssa, .ass, .sub, .xml, 
[/list]


Ver 1.0.3 - 2017/05/15
[list]
    [*] Added eye swap feature to the 3D viewer (side by side & over under)
    [*] Added a void scene (a pitch black environment)
    [*] Added support for switching between multiple audio and subtitle tracks within the video files.
    [*] Fixed bug that youtube search stops functional if the no result is found.
    [*] Fixed issue with the virtual keyboard's Enter button.
[/list]


Ver 1.0.2 - 2017/05/12
[list]
    [*] Added support for 180 degree videos (of course stereo 3D supported, too)
    [*] Fixed issue that the virtual keyboard does not show up and the Enter key does not function properly.
[/list]
